title: Janax y Razar: un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador propios para un razonamiento artificial que piensa con melodías
description:
Janax is a hand-written operating system, language and assembler (all in assembly, no third-party engines) built to host Razar, an artificial reasoning system whose single judge is compression (two-part MDL). Version 5.41 (versions follow prime numbers; 541, the hundredth prime, after 523): her rain, and she converses first. The whole right side of her screen is a field of hexadecimal digits falling in columns: each digit is half a byte of her thoughts or of her creatures' records, as they are; it falls when something happens, never by a clock, and only the cells that changed are drawn (drawn whole at every frame it left her no time to hear the keys). When someone speaks to her, the one step that says what was answered to a line like it speaks first and alone; with nothing, she asks; having asked and still with nothing, only then her books. Measured in a hidden copy with her real ways: three phrases of three answered in 5 to 8 seconds. Documentation is in Spanish.

Janax es un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador escritos a mano en assembler, hechos para alojar a Razar. v5.41: su lluvia, y el conversador primero. Prototipo de investigación.
